title: A deep learning image-based intrinsic molecular subtype classifier of breast tumors reveals tumor heterogeneity that may affect survival.
summary: A deep image classifier predicts PAM50 breast-tumor subtypes from H&E slides in held-out tumors and examines heterogeneity related to survival; this is a specific retrospective pathology result.
